exercise.question: lekarna
exercise.explanation_sl: Lekarna = pharmacy (v Veliki Britaniji tudi chemist's).

exercise.question: Glava me boli.
exercise.explanation_sl: Headache = glavobol. Toothache = zobobol, cold = prehlad, fever = vročina.

exercise.question: zamuda
exercise.explanation_sl: Zamuda = delay. Departure = odhod, arrival = prihod, platform = peron.

exercise.question: blagajna
exercise.explanation_sl: Blagajna = checkout. Receipt = račun, discount = popust, trolley = voziček.
Račun iz trgovine = receipt. Račun v restavraciji = bill.

exercise.question: prtljaga
exercise.explanation_sl: Prtljaga = luggage. Boarding pass = vstopni kupon.

exercise.question: one book, two ___
exercise.explanation_sl: Množino navadno tvorimo s končnico -s: books.

exercise.question: I have ___ orange.
exercise.explanation_sl: Pred samoglasnikom (a, e, i, o, u) uporabimo »an«: an orange.

exercise.question: Peter is my husband. ___ is a doctor.

exercise.sentence: There are three ___ on the table. (box)
exercise.explanation_sl: Besede na -x, -s, -sh, -ch dobijo v množini -es: boxes.

exercise.question: We ___ in Ljubljana.
exercise.explanation_sl: Z »we« glagol ostane brez končnice: we live.

exercise.question: ___ a bank near the station.
exercise.explanation_sl: »Je / obstaja« za eno stvar = there is; za več stvari = there are.

exercise.sentence: This is my brother. ___ name is Tomaž.

exercise.question: I ___ two children.
exercise.explanation_sl: I / you / we / they have; he / she / it has.

exercise.question: My husband ___ coffee every morning.
exercise.explanation_sl: Pri he / she / it dodamo glagolu -s: he drinks.

exercise.question: ___ you like fish?
exercise.explanation_sl: Vprašanje z »you« začnemo z »Do«: Do you like …?
Zanikanje pri he / she / it: doesn't + glagol.

exercise.question: Look! It ___.
exercise.explanation_sl: Za nekaj, kar se dogaja prav zdaj, uporabimo is + -ing: it is raining.

exercise.sentence: Is there ___ milk in the fridge?
exercise.explanation_sl: V vprašanjih in zanikanju navadno uporabimo »any«.

exercise.question: The train is ___ than the bus.
Next summer we ___ visit my sister in London.
exercise.explanation_sl: Načrte izrazimo z am / is / are + going to.
Have you ever been …? = Si že kdaj bila …?

exercise.question: You have a fever. You ___ see a doctor.

questions.question: Kje je Maja?

questions.question: Kakšno bo vreme jutri?

exercise.text: Mark is my neighbour. He is seventy. He has a small dog. The dog's name is Max.

questions.question: Kdo je Max?

exercise.explanation_sl: »The dog's name is Max« = pes se imenuje Max.

exercise.title: Doctor's office
exercise.text:
Open: Monday – Friday, 7:00 – 13:00
Phone: 01 234 567

questions.question: Ali je ambulanta odprta v soboto?

exercise.explanation_sl: Odprta je od ponedeljka (Monday) do petka (Friday).

exercise.text: I get up at seven o'clock. I have coffee and toast for breakfast. Then I take the bus to work.

questions.question: What does the writer eat for breakfast?

exercise.explanation_sl: »I have coffee and toast for breakfast« = za zajtrk ima kavo in toast.

exercise.text: Dear Anna, thank you for the flowers! They are beautiful. Come for coffee on Saturday. Love, Vesna

questions.question: Why does Vesna write to Anna?

exercise.explanation_sl: Vesna se zahvaljuje za rože: »thank you for the flowers«.

exercise.text: Our flat has two bedrooms, a small kitchen and a big living room. There is no garden, but there is a balcony.

questions.question: What does the flat NOT have?

exercise.text: SPECIAL OFFER! 2 kg of apples – only 3 €. Today only!

questions.question: When can you buy the apples at this price?

exercise.text: My sister Mojca lives in Maribor. She works in a hospital. She doesn't like cooking, so she often eats in a restaurant near her work.

questions.question: Why does Mojca often eat in a restaurant?

exercise.explanation_sl: »She doesn't like cooking, so …« = ne mara kuhati, zato …

exercise.text: The train to Koper leaves from platform 3 at 10:45. Please have your ticket ready.

questions.question: Where does the train leave from?

exercise.text: Take one tablet three times a day after meals. Do not take more than six tablets in one day.

questions.question: When should you take the tablet?

exercise.text: On Sundays we usually visit my parents. My mother makes soup and my father tells stories about his old job. We always stay for dinner.

questions.question: What does the father do on Sundays?

exercise.explanation_sl: »My father tells stories« = oče pripoveduje zgodbe.

exercise.text: Last summer we went to Croatia for a week. The weather was hot and sunny, so we swam in the sea every day. One evening it rained, so we stayed in our apartment and played cards. The food was very good, but the restaurants were expensive.

questions.question: What did they do on the rainy evening?

exercise.explanation_sl: »One evening it rained, so we … played cards« = tisti večer so igrali karte.

exercise.text: Hi Petra, I'm sorry, but I can't come to the café tomorrow. My son is ill and I'm taking him to the doctor in the morning. Can we meet on Friday instead? Nina

questions.question: Why can't Nina meet Petra tomorrow?

exercise.explanation_sl: »My son is ill« = moj sin je bolan.

exercise.text: Cut two onions and fry them in a little oil. Add the tomatoes and cook for ten minutes. Then add salt and some fresh basil.

questions.question: What do you do after you fry the onions?

exercise.explanation_sl: Po praženju čebule dodamo paradižnik (»Add the tomatoes«).

exercise.title: Notice
exercise.text: The lift is not working this week. We are sorry. Please use the stairs. If you need help with heavy shopping bags, call the caretaker on 041 555 123.

questions.question: What should you do if you have heavy bags?

exercise.text: I have lived in this town for thirty years, and it has changed a lot. When I was young, there was only one small shop. Now there are two supermarkets, a pharmacy and a big car park. Life is easier now, but I miss the old market, where everybody knew your name. On Saturdays I still go to the farmers' market in the next village.

questions.question: What does the writer miss?

exercise.explanation_sl: »I miss the old market« = pogrešam staro tržnico.

exercise.text: Dear Mrs Novak, your appointment with Dr Kos has been moved from Tuesday 14 May to Thursday 16 May at 9:30. Please arrive ten minutes early and bring your health card. If this time is not suitable, please call us before Wednesday.

questions.question: What should Mrs Novak do if she can't come on Thursday?

exercise.explanation_sl: »If this time is not suitable, please call us before Wednesday« = če ji termin ne ustreza, naj pokliče pred sredo.

exercise.text: Tomorrow morning will be cloudy and cool, with temperatures around 12 °C. In the afternoon, strong winds will bring heavy rain to the west of the country. The east will stay dry until the evening.

questions.question: Where will it rain in the afternoon?

exercise.explanation_sl: »Heavy rain to the west« = močan dež na zahodu.

exercise.text: My grandson is going to start university in September. He is going to study medicine in Ljubljana, so he is looking for a room near the faculty. Rooms in the city centre are more expensive than rooms outside the city, but he doesn't want to spend hours on the bus.

questions.question: Why doesn't he want a room outside the city?
options: He doesn't want to spend a lot of time on the bus.
He wants to live with his grandmother.

exercise.explanation_sl: »He doesn't want to spend hours on the bus« = noče preživeti ur na avtobusu.
